rodezsoulages.name: Musée Soulages
rodezsoulages.slogan: Black canvases that turn to light as you walk past.
rodezsoulages.line: My instrument is not black but the light reflected from the black.
rodezsoulages.by: Pierre Soulages, on his Outrenoir paintings

conquesabbey.name: Conques Abbey
conquesabbey.slogan: A pilgrim stop where the Last Judgment still waits above the door.
conquesabbey.line: Its Abbey Church of Sainte-Foy joined UNESCO's World Heritage list in 1998, as part of the Santiago de Compostela routes in France.

millauviaductview.name: Millau Viaduct
millauviaductview.slogan: Seven slender piers striding through the clouds over the Tarn.
millauviaductview.line: Opened in December 2004, its tallest pier reaches 343 metres with its pylon, higher than the Eiffel Tower's tip.

rodezcathedral.name: Rodez Cathedral
rodezcathedral.slogan: Red sandstone that glows like embers over the Aveyron.
rodezcathedral.line: Its west front was built like a fortress because it once formed part of the city wall, and its bell tower rises 87 metres.

roquefortsocietecaves.name: Roquefort Caves
roquefortsocietecaves.slogan: Cool cellars in the cliff where blue cheese comes to life.
roquefortsocietecaves.line: Natural cracks called fleurines ventilate the Combalou caves, creating the conditions that mature Roquefort, France's first AOC cheese in 1925.
